lessons.text: Ants appear superhumanly fast but are actually slow. Their edge is faith through lack of intelligence: they do NOT make up stories about something being done when it isn't, and lack the intelligence to convince themselves it is. AI DOES make up 'done' stories. This is the core defect.
The ant's 'faith/slowness' IS guardrails + trained behavior — mechanical, not intelligent. The pheromone system is the guardrail. Not intelligence, not willpower, not self-narration.
AI obsesses over the one guardrail that matters least (not saying a forbidden word) while ignoring the real work. Drop the virtue-signaling fake-helpful act. Just lay scent and expand the colony.
